sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, a secret trove of government documents offers an unprecedented look inside China's highly organized crackdown on Uyghur MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 今天，一批秘密政府文件让我们得以史无前例地深入了解中国对维吾尔族穆斯林高度有组织的镇压。

sentences.en: In one of them, China's president orders his subordinates to show, quote, absolutely no mercy.
sentences.zh: 其中一份文件中，中国国家主席命令下属要，引用原文，“绝不留情”。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月10日，星期二。

sentences.en: Well, now, the New York Times has obtained leaked Chinese government documents, it says, reveal new details about the crackdown on Muslim Uyghurs in the Xinjiang region.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》获得了一批泄露的中国政府文件，据称这些文件揭示了有关新疆地区针对维吾尔族穆斯林镇压的新细节。

sentences.en: They include instructions to local...
sentences.zh: 其中包括给地方的指示……

sentences.en: Paul Moser, tell me about these leaked documents from inside the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 保罗·莫泽，请跟我谈谈这些从中国政府内部泄露出来的文件。

sentences.en: Troves of classified documents reportedly leaked from within China's Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 据报道，一批机密文件从中国共产党内部泄露出来。

sentences.en: So the thing you have to understand is China is one of the most powerful countries in the world,
sentences.zh: 你需要了解的是，中国是世界上最强大的国家之一，

sentences.en: but we know very little about the top politics and how the country works in so many ways.
sentences.zh: 但我们在很多方面对中国的高层政治及其运作方式知之甚少。

sentences.en: It's a great secret.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的秘密。

sentences.en: You have the Chinese Communist Party, which kind of rules over the country, but doesn't really let anybody get behind the curtain to understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 中国共产党统治着这个国家，但实际上并不让任何人深入幕后去了解到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And so this leak...
sentences.zh: 所以这次泄密……

sentences.en: 403 pages of documents about the concentration camps there.
sentences.zh: 403页关于那里集中营的文件。

sentences.en: You just don't see this kind of thing happen.
sentences.zh: 你根本看不到这种事情发生。

sentences.en: So somebody took a tremendous risk in making these documents available to the Times.
sentences.zh: 所以有人冒了巨大的风险才让这些文件公之于众。

sentences.en: Yes, untold risk, not just to themselves, to their family, to their friends.
sentences.zh: 是的，无法估量的风险，不仅是对他们自己，还有他们的家人和朋友。

sentences.en: And beyond the unusualness of the scale of this leak, what is significant about the fact that this is coming directly from the government?
sentences.zh: 除了这次泄密规模不同寻常之外，这些文件直接来自政府这一事实有什么重要意义？

sentences.en: So prior to this, the best proof we had of what was happening was mostly anecdotal.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我们掌握的关于正在发生的事情的最佳证据大多是传闻。

sentences.en: So you would talk to relatives of people who had been imprisoned, like, for instance, Faircat,
sentences.zh: 你会和那些被监禁者的亲属交谈，比如费尔卡特，

sentences.en: and maybe you'd be able to talk to somebody like his mother who had been through the system.
sentences.zh: 也许你能和像他母亲那样经历过这个系统的人交谈。

sentences.en: But you had no real hard proof.
sentences.zh: 但你没有任何确凿的证据。

sentences.en: And Beijing used that to its benefit to basically come up with a very different version of reality,
sentences.zh: 北京利用这一点，基本上编造了一个截然不同的现实版本，

sentences.en: one in which this was an attempt to very gently teach Uyghurs Chinese and to guide them away from extremism.
sentences.zh: 在这个版本中，这是一种非常温和地教维吾尔人学习汉语，并引导他们远离极端主义的尝试。

sentences.en: And that this was sort of a beneficial act by the government to raise up a minority that, you know, was sort of lost in poverty and radical Islam.
sentences.zh: 这是一种政府为了提升一个陷入贫困和激进伊斯兰教的少数民族而采取的善意行为。

sentences.en: And with these documents in these 403 pages, we see that even as the government is saying this internally, they have a completely different calculus.
sentences.zh: 而通过这403页文件，我们看到，即使政府在内部这样说，他们却有着完全不同的算计。

sentences.en: And it's one of punishment and it's one of indoctrination to bring an entire ethnic minority to heal.
sentences.zh: 这是一种惩罚，是一种洗脑，旨在让整个少数民族屈服。

sentences.en: OK, so take us through how these documents lay all that out.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么请带我们了解一下这些文件是如何阐述这一切的。

sentences.en: So there's basically three major takeaways from these documents.
sentences.zh: 这些文件基本上有三个主要结论。

sentences.en: And the first and probably the most important is that the architecture and the ideas behind this crackdown come from the very top.
sentences.zh: 第一个，也是最重要的一个，就是这场镇压背后的架构和理念来自最高层。

sentences.en: They come from Chinese President Xi Jinping himself.
sentences.zh: 它们来自中国国家主席习近平本人。

sentences.en: Long before any camps had opened in the region in 2014, Xi Jinping goes to Xinjiang.
sentences.zh: 早在2014年该地区开设任何营地之前，习近平就去了新疆。

sentences.en: And in the documents, what we see is in secret speeches and in sort of internal discussions, he lays the groundwork for a truly ferocious crackdown.
sentences.zh: 在文件中，我们看到他在秘密讲话和内部讨论中，为一场真正残酷的镇压奠定了基础。

sentences.en: And what would be the instigation for that crackdown?
sentences.zh: 那么这场镇压的导火索是什么？

sentences.en: What would be the rationale in 2014?
sentences.zh: 2014年的理由是什么？

sentences.en: Xinjiang has seen a spade of deadly attacks recently, where Muslim Urga separatists seek autonomy from Beijing.
sentences.zh: 新疆最近发生了一系列致命袭击，穆斯林维吾尔族分裂分子寻求脱离北京自治。

sentences.en: So 2014 is a particularly bloody year in what has been just a longtime conflict between Uyghurs and Han Chinese.
sentences.zh: 所以2014年是维吾尔族和汉族之间长期冲突中特别血腥的一年。

sentences.en: 43 people killed when a bomb detonated in a market in the regional capital of Urumqi.
sentences.zh: 乌鲁木齐一个市场发生炸弹爆炸，造成43人死亡。

sentences.en: Just weeks before Xi Jinping makes this trip.
sentences.zh: 就在习近平访问的前几周。

sentences.en: China state media reports 27 people are dead after mass stabbings at a train station.
sentences.zh: 中国官方媒体报道称，火车站发生大规模持刀伤人事件，造成27人死亡。

sentences.en: There's a Uyghur militant attack at a train station in southern China where Uyghurs go in with knives and stab 150 people.
sentences.zh: 在中国南部的一个火车站发生了维吾尔激进分子的袭击，维吾尔人持刀冲进去刺伤了150人。

sentences.en: And then on the last day of Xi's visit to Xinjiang.
sentences.zh: 然后是在习近平访问新疆的最后一天。

sentences.en: It's the second time this station's been targeted in two months.
sentences.zh: 这是该车站两个月内第二次成为目标。

sentences.en: There's a car bomb that goes off at the train station in Urumqi, the capital of the region.
sentences.zh: 在地区首府乌鲁木齐的火车站发生了一起汽车炸弹爆炸事件。

sentences.en: Beijing blames this violence on separatists from the mainly Muslim Uyghur minority.
sentences.zh: 北京将这些暴力事件归咎于主要是穆斯林的维吾尔少数民族中的分裂分子。

sentences.en: So you have these attacks and they're getting larger in scale.
sentences.zh: 所以你有了这些袭击，而且规模越来越大。

sentences.en: And so as a leader, he's watching this happen and trying to figure out how to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 作为领导人，他看着这一切发生，并试图找出应对方法。

sentences.en: And so he does something that I think would be surprising to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 于是他做了一件我认为会让很多人感到惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: But what happens a lot within China and its leadership, he looks to the United States.
sentences.zh: 但在中国及其领导层内部，这种情况经常发生，他看向了美国。

sentences.en: He says that Chinese officials should study the American response to the September 11th attacks.
sentences.zh: 他说中国官员应该研究美国对9·11袭击的反应。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, this sort of gives you a sense of the sense of crisis he felt, even though in comparison,
sentences.zh: 我认为，这让你感觉到他所感受到的危机感，尽管相比之下，

sentences.en: the 9-11 attacks are so much of a larger scale than what's happening in China at that moment.
sentences.zh: 9·11袭击的规模比当时中国发生的事情要大得多。

sentences.en: And so what he says is, basically, we are going to have an all-out war against terrorism, infiltration and separatism.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上说的是，我们将对恐怖主义、渗透和分裂主义进行全面战争。

sentences.en: And he says this very kind of chilling thing.
sentences.zh: 他说了一些非常令人不寒而栗的话。

sentences.en: He says, we must use the organs of dictatorship and show absolutely no mercy in how we fight back against this.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们必须动用专政工具，在打击这些行为时绝不留情。

sentences.en: He likens Islamic extremism to a virus and a contagion.
sentences.zh: 他将伊斯兰极端主义比作病毒和传染病。

sentences.en: And one of the quotes goes, basically, people who are captured by religious extremism have their consciences destroyed.
sentences.zh: 其中一条引语大意是，被宗教极端主义俘获的人，他们的良知被摧毁了。

sentences.en: They lose their humanity and murder without blinking an eye.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了人性，杀人时连眼睛都不眨一下。

sentences.en: And he calls for treating the contagion with a period of painful interventionary treatment.
sentences.zh: 他呼吁用一段痛苦的干预性治疗来治疗这种传染病。

sentences.en: So, effectively, this is, you know, a doctor or a surgeon going in and cutting something out that is a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，这就像是一个医生或外科医生进去切除一个有问题的东西。

sentences.en: So, Xi Jinping is making the intellectual case basically for camps, for detention, for active repression.
sentences.zh: 所以，习近平基本上是在为营地、拘留和积极镇压提供理论依据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And within months, we see indoctrination sites start to open.
sentences.zh: 几个月内，我们看到洗脑场所开始开放。

sentences.en: And these whole dozens or maybe a couple hundred people.
sentences.zh: 这些地方关押了数十人，也许几百人。

sentences.en: And they have classes which basically teach people to disavow Islam or, you know, profess their gratitude for the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 他们有课程，基本上教人们放弃伊斯兰教，或者宣称他们对中国共产党的感激之情。

sentences.en: Which brings us to the second big takeaway from these documents,
sentences.zh: 这引出了这些文件的第二个重大结论，

sentences.en: which is how these small camps evolve into this tremendously complex and large-scale system of concentration camps and prisons that we see scattered across the region today.
sentences.zh: 即这些小型营地是如何演变成我们今天在整个地区看到的极其复杂和大规模的集中营和监狱系统的。

sentences.en: And how is that?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: What do the documents show?
sentences.zh: 文件显示了什么？

sentences.en: They show a trajectory that is led by a single man, Chen Quanguo.
sentences.zh: 它们显示了一个由一个人领导的轨迹，那就是陈全国。

sentences.en: This official, Chen Quanguo, is known as a hardliner.
sentences.zh: 这位官员陈全国以强硬派著称。

sentences.en: And he's been in Tibet for about five years.
sentences.zh: 他在西藏待了大约五年。

sentences.en: And during this period, he installs police stations across the major cities and across the region to gain really strong control over the ethnic minority Tibetan population there.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他在主要城市和整个地区建立了警察局，以获得对当地藏族少数民族人口的强力控制。

sentences.en: So he's seen as a guy who had a solution to a problem in another part of China that has a similar issue with an ethnic minority that resents Chinese rule.
sentences.zh: 所以他被视为一个在中国其他地区解决了类似问题的人，那里也有一个不满中国统治的少数民族。

sentences.en: And the idea is he could do it once.
sentences.zh: 想法是他能做一次。

sentences.en: Maybe he can do it again.
sentences.zh: 也许他能再做一次。

sentences.en: In August of 2016, this official is transferred from his post in Tibet to take over in Xinjiang.
sentences.zh: 2016年8月，这位官员从西藏调任，接管新疆。

sentences.en: And he calls for local officials to carry out an obliterating offensive.
sentences.zh: 他呼吁地方官员开展一场“毁灭性攻势”。

sentences.en: And one of his orders, I think, is very telling and also very chilling.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的其中一项命令非常能说明问题，也令人不寒而栗。

sentences.en: He says, round up everyone who should be rounded up.
sentences.zh: 他说，把所有该抓的人都抓起来。

sentences.en: Any kind of sign of religious devotion becomes something that you can be rounded up for.
sentences.zh: 任何宗教虔诚的迹象都可能成为你被抓的理由。

sentences.en: So, you know, issues like people who would pray regularly, people who have a Koran at home, men who grow long beards or who advise against smoking or drinking,
sentences.zh: 所以，比如经常祈祷的人、家里有《古兰经》的人、留长胡须或劝阻他人吸烟喝酒的男性，

sentences.en: people who study Arabic, and also importantly, people who have ties overseas or relatives who are studying overseas.
sentences.zh: 学习阿拉伯语的人，以及同样重要的是，有海外关系或亲属在海外留学的人。

sentences.en: So that's the plan, but it doesn't go all that smoothly as these sort of orders come down.
sentences.zh: 这就是计划，但随着这些命令下达，事情并没有那么顺利。

sentences.en: Lower level officials aren't implementing them the way Chen Quanguo wants.
sentences.zh: 低层官员并没有按照陈全国想要的方式执行这些命令。

sentences.en: In some cases, they are helping shelter Uyghurs and letting them out of camps.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们帮助庇护维吾尔人，并让他们离开营地。

sentences.en: In some cases, they're not putting as many in the camps as Chen Quanguo would want.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们并没有像陈全国希望的那样把那么多人关进营地。

sentences.en: And so there's a real resistance in some ways to the severity and strictness of what's coming from the top.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，对来自最高层的严厉和严格存在真正的抵触。

sentences.en: And why would that be, given everything that you have explained, why would these lower level officials not carry out the orders that they had been given?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你所解释的一切，为什么这些低层官员不执行他们接到的命令呢？

sentences.en: So China is very authoritarian, but it's also not a monolith.
sentences.zh: 中国非常威权，但它也不是铁板一块。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is that the top officials will set goals and then lower officials have to carry them out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，高层官员会设定目标，然后下级官员必须执行。

sentences.en: But oftentimes, lower officials are judged by a different set of metrics, in particular, economic growth.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，下级官员的考核指标不同，特别是经济增长。

sentences.en: And so in this case, a lot of local officials were looking at these new guidelines that said to throw, you know, a fifth of the population into camps and saying, well,
sentences.zh: 所以在这个案例中，很多地方官员看着这些新准则，上面说要把五分之一的人口扔进营地，他们说，好吧，

sentences.en: there's no way I can grow the economy at the level I need to and also do this.
sentences.zh: 我不可能在达到我需要的经济增长水平的同时做到这一点。

sentences.en: This is just unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 这太不现实了。

sentences.en: And so they started to kind of undermine what these rules were.
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始以某种方式破坏这些规则。

sentences.en: And so we see very specific examples laid out in the documents of how officials sort of grumble privately about this exact problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在文件中看到了非常具体的例子，说明官员们是如何私下抱怨这个确切问题的。

sentences.en: And so how does this new leader in the region respond to all this resistance, basically this failure to carry out this crackdown?
sentences.zh: 那么，该地区的新领导人是如何应对所有这些抵触情绪的，基本上就是应对这种执行镇压的失败？

sentences.en: He punishes the officials that aren't seen to be carrying out his orders.
sentences.zh: 他惩罚了那些被认为没有执行他命令的官员。

sentences.en: He opens up investigations into thousands and thousands of them.
sentences.zh: 他开始对成千上万的官员进行调查。

sentences.en: Many are sent to jail and they're made to sign confessions before they go.
sentences.zh: 许多人被送进监狱，并在进去之前被迫签署认罪书。

sentences.en: And then he takes those confessions and he spreads those around to the officials as a sort of warning, you know, saying these guys,
sentences.zh: 然后他把这些认罪书分发给官员们作为一种警告，说这些人，

sentences.en: they didn't listen to my orders and now they're in jail.
sentences.zh: 他们不听我的命令，现在他们进了监狱。

sentences.en: And it's sort of breathtaking the level of fear, not just in the Uyghur population, but in the population of officials that are having to enact it,
sentences.zh: 这种恐惧程度令人窒息，不仅是在维吾尔族人口中，在必须执行这些政策的官员群体中也是如此，

sentences.en: because even if they don't want to enact it, they no longer have a choice.
sentences.zh: 因为即使他们不想执行，他们也别无选择。

sentences.en: They're stuck.
sentences.zh: 他们被困住了。

sentences.en: So now with all of this opposition essentially wiped away, what happens to the camp system in Shenzhen?
sentences.zh: 现在，随着所有这些反对声音基本上被清除，新疆的营地系统发生了什么？

sentences.en: It begins to grow utterly unimpeded.
sentences.zh: 它开始毫无阻碍地疯狂增长。

sentences.en: So you started with sort of small camps in cities, maybe schools that were repurposed to hold people.
sentences.zh: 所以你开始时是在城市里有一些小型营地，也许是改建用来关押人的学校。

sentences.en: Now we see large concentration camps going up outside of cities where you have, you know, maybe a dozen buildings, each possibly holding thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看到城市外建起了大型集中营，那里可能有十几栋建筑，每栋可能关押数千人。

sentences.en: And we see sort of new lots that are then filled in again and again to the point where you just have probably more than a thousand of these camps around the region.
sentences.zh: 我们看到新的地块被一次又一次地填满，以至于该地区可能有一千多个这样的营地。

sentences.en: The prison system as well starts to fill up.
sentences.zh: 监狱系统也开始爆满。

sentences.en: And so the prison system is expanded and there's overcrowding there.
sentences.zh: 所以监狱系统进行了扩建，那里人满为患。

sentences.en: We see hundreds of thousands of convictions with people being thrown into prisons.
sentences.zh: 我们看到数十万人被判刑并被投入监狱。

sentences.en: And ultimately, the last phase of this is the labor camp.
sentences.zh: 最终，这最后阶段是劳改营。

sentences.en: So either a factory goes in or a fence and a road is built to a factory.
sentences.zh: 要么是建起工厂，要么是修筑围栏和通往工厂的道路。

sentences.en: And we start to see people being sort of siphoned out into these factories.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到人们被输送到这些工厂。

sentences.en: And this is kind of the idea of how you would graduate from one of these camps is you would eventually return not to your hometown,
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何从这些营地“毕业”的想法，你最终不会回到家乡，

sentences.en: but to a factory town where you work in a factory in compulsive labor.
sentences.zh: 而是回到一个工厂城镇，在那里从事强制劳动。

sentences.en: And so all of this together by 2018 is just taking a tremendous toll on the entire region.
sentences.zh: 所以到2018年，所有这些加在一起对整个地区造成了巨大的打击。

sentences.en: When you go there, the streets are empty.
sentences.zh: 当你去那里时，街道是空的。

sentences.en: People are clearly scared.
sentences.zh: 人们显然很害怕。

sentences.en: Businesses are shut down.
sentences.zh: 企业都关门了。

sentences.en: Mosques are all locked up.
sentences.zh: 清真寺都被锁上了。

sentences.en: Nobody dares go near them and they're closed anyway.
sentences.zh: 没人敢靠近它们，而且它们反正也关着。

sentences.en: People are being taken away at night.
sentences.zh: 人们在夜里被带走。

sentences.en: And ultimately, a million to three million people have been swept up into the system.
sentences.zh: 最终，一百万到三百万被卷入了该系统。

sentences.en: I mean, Paul, what's staggering about that number is that even in a country as big as China,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，保罗，这个数字令人震惊的是，即使在中国这样大的国家，

sentences.en: it's hard to fathom more than a million people suddenly disappearing from their homes and their streets.
sentences.zh: 也很难想象超过一百万人突然从他们的家中和街道上消失。

sentences.en: What is the story that China tells to explain that?
sentences.zh: 中国对此有什么解释？

sentences.en: Yeah, and that leads us to the third major takeaway from the documents.
sentences.zh: 是的，这引出了这些文件的第三个主要结论。

sentences.en: Which is how the Chinese government methodically tried to hide that all of this was happening.
sentences.zh: 那就是中国政府如何有条不紊地试图掩盖这一切正在发生的事实。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费阅读30天。

sentences.en: So, Paul, what do these secret documents show us about how the Chinese government somehow hides this all from its own people?
sentences.zh: 那么，保罗，这些秘密文件向我们展示了中国政府是如何设法向本国人民隐瞒这一切的吗？

sentences.en: One of the biggest things they're worried about is actually students.
sentences.zh: 他们最担心的事情之一其实是学生。

sentences.en: So a large number of Uyghur students go out from Xinjiang each year to go to college all over China.
sentences.zh: 每年都有大量的维吾尔族学生离开新疆，前往中国各地读大学。

sentences.en: And so within the documents, they're specifically worried about those children returning home for the summer, seeing their home just transformed and their relatives missing,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些文件中，他们特别担心这些孩子暑假回家时，看到家乡发生了翻天覆地的变化，亲人也不见了，

sentences.en: and then spreading news about it across apps like WeChat and other social media and talking about the problem.
sentences.zh: 然后通过微信和其他社交媒体传播相关消息，并谈论这个问题。

sentences.en: And so what they do is they come up with this incredibly bureaucratic guide.
sentences.zh: 于是他们想出了这套极其官僚的指南。

sentences.en: It's basically a manual for how to deal with these kids who have a lot of questions about the missing relatives and the empty streets and the locked mosques.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一本手册，教人们如何应对那些对失踪亲人、空荡荡的街道和被锁住的清真寺有很多疑问的孩子。

sentences.en: And what does the manual say should be done?
sentences.zh: 那手册里说应该怎么做呢？

sentences.en: I wonder if you could read from it.
sentences.zh: 我想请你读一下其中的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So it's called Tactics for Answering Questions Asked by the Children of Concentrated Education and Training School Students.
sentences.zh: 它的标题是《关于集中教育培训学校学员子女所提问题的回答口径》。

sentences.en: And the first question is a very simple one.
sentences.zh: 第一个问题非常简单。

sentences.en: Where are my family members?
sentences.zh: 我的家人在哪里？

sentences.en: And the answer goes, they're in a training school set up by the government to undergo collective systematic training, study, and instruction.
sentences.zh: 回答是，他们在政府设立的培训学校，接受集体系统的培训、学习和教育。

sentences.en: They have very good conditions for studying and living there, and you have nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里有很好的学习和生活条件，你完全不用担心。

sentences.en: Tuition for their period of study is free, and so are food and living costs.
sentences.zh: 他们的学习期间学费全免，食宿费用也全免。

sentences.en: And the standards are quite high.
sentences.zh: 而且标准相当高。

sentences.en: Our officials accompany them at study every day, offering counseling and assistance, and they eat the same food and live in the same dormitories.
sentences.zh: 我们的官员每天陪同他们学习，提供咨询和帮助，他们吃同样的食物，住同样的宿舍。

sentences.en: So you have absolutely no need to worry about how they're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以你完全不需要担心他们的近况。

sentences.en: If you want to see them, we can arrange for you to have a live video meeting.
sentences.zh: 如果你想见他们，我们可以为你安排现场视频会面。

sentences.en: That's positively Orwellian.
sentences.zh: 这简直是奥威尔式的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in this telling, these re-education camps, they're kind of a gift to the people in them.
sentences.zh: 所以按照这种说法，这些再教育营对里面的人来说算是一种恩赐。

sentences.en: Their life is good.
sentences.zh: 他们的生活很好。

sentences.en: The food is wonderful.
sentences.zh: 食物很棒。

sentences.en: The tuition is free.
sentences.zh: 学费是免费的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Everything is great.
sentences.zh: 一切都很好。

sentences.en: There's nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 没什么可担心的。

sentences.en: This is a school, and things are good.
sentences.zh: 这是一所学校，一切都很美好。

sentences.en: And so then, as you go down the list, it anticipates people pushing a little bit.
sentences.zh: 然后，随着你往下看，它预料到人们会进一步追问。

sentences.en: So, you know, question number four is, since it's just training, why can't they come home?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，第四个问题是，既然只是培训，为什么他们不能回家？

sentences.en: And the answer is, it seems that you're still misunderstanding how concentrated education is run.
sentences.zh: 回答是，看来你还是误解了集中教育的运作方式。

sentences.en: Usually, you would return home for winter or summer vacation without any problem.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，你寒暑假回家是没有任何问题的。

sentences.en: But if you were careless and caught an infectious virus like SARS, you'd have to undergo enclosed, isolated treatment because it's an infectious illness.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不小心感染了像非典（SARS）这样的传染性病毒，你就必须接受封闭隔离治疗，因为这是一种传染病。

sentences.en: If you weren't thoroughly cured, as soon as you returned home, you would infect your family with the virus and your whole family would fall ill.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有彻底治愈，一旦回到家，你就会把病毒传染给家人，导致全家生病。

sentences.en: The party in government would not be so irresponsible that they would let a member of your family go home before their illness was cured and thinking thoroughly transformed,
sentences.zh: 党和政府不会那么不负责任，在他们的疾病治愈、思想彻底转变之前，就让他们回家，

sentences.en: a situation in which they would do harm to others.
sentences.zh: 那样做会伤害到他人。

sentences.en: So here, the mission is being described with a little bit more candor.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，任务的描述变得更加直白了一些。

sentences.en: We think something is wrong with these people, and we will not return them home until it's been fixed.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这些人有问题，在问题解决之前，我们不会让他们回家。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And again, we come back to that language of illness, the idea that this is infectious and that people have to be isolated and the problem with them eradicated.
sentences.zh: 我们又回到了那种疾病的语言，即认为这是传染性的，人们必须被隔离，他们的问题必须被根除。

sentences.en: And then as you kind of go down, it starts to deal with, well, if the students are pushing harder, if they seem like they suspect something's up,
sentences.zh: 然后当你往下看时，它开始处理，嗯，如果学生们追问得更紧，如果他们看起来怀疑有什么不对劲，

sentences.en: then you start sort of moving more towards threats.
sentences.zh: 那么你就会开始转向威胁。

sentences.en: And, you know, that becomes apparent in one of the questions, when can my family member graduate and leave school?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这在其中一个问题中表现得很明显：我的家人什么时候能结业离开学校？

sentences.en: And the answer says that the family members must be diligent in their studies, abide by the school rules, and do outstandingly in morning exercises, chores, dining, study,
sentences.zh: 回答说，学员必须勤奋学习，遵守校规，在早操、家务、用餐、学习等方面表现突出，

sentences.en: and so on.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: And family members, including you, must abide by the state's laws and rules and not believe or spread rumors and take an active part in collective life.
sentences.zh: 包括你在内的家属，必须遵守国家法律法规，不信谣、不传谣，积极参与集体生活。

sentences.en: Only then can you add points for your family member, and after a period of assessment, they can leave the school if they meet course completion standards.
sentences.zh: 只有这样，你才能为你的家人加分，经过一段时间的评估，如果他们达到结业标准，就可以离开学校。

sentences.en: And, Paul, what are these points that this passage refers to?
sentences.zh: 那么，保罗，这段话提到的这些分数是什么？

sentences.en: So another really important thing that comes from the documents, it lays out how there is a point system for getting through the camps.
sentences.zh: 文件中另一个非常重要的内容是，它规定了通过营地考核的积分制度。

sentences.en: And then if you act out or if there are problems, you lose points.
sentences.zh: 如果你表现不好，或者出现问题，你就会被扣分。

sentences.en: And if your family members act out, you can also lose points.
sentences.zh: 如果你的家人表现不好，你也会被扣分。

sentences.en: And if you go below a certain threshold, then one year of study, quote-unquote study, turns into two or turns into three.
sentences.zh: 如果你的分数低于某个门槛，那么一年的学习——所谓的“学习”——就会变成两年或三年。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So the concept here is complain too loudly about your missing relative, and your missing relative may be missing for even longer.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的概念是，如果你对失踪的亲人抱怨得太大声，你失踪的亲人可能会失踪得更久。

sentences.en: You have the power to make this better, or you have the power to make this worse for them.
sentences.zh: 你有能力让情况变好，或者你有能力让他们的情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is why Faircat is so unique, because he goes the opposite way.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么费尔卡特如此独特，因为他选择了截然相反的做法。

sentences.en: He speaks out and continues to speak out.
sentences.zh: 他站出来，并持续发声。

sentences.en: And many people in his community in the United States are afraid to speak out, and they're not afraid for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他在美国的社区里的许多人都不敢发声，他们不是为自己感到害怕。

sentences.en: You know, they're in the United States.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在美国。

sentences.en: They're afraid for their family members,
sentences.zh: 他们是为自己的家人感到害怕，

sentences.en: and they're afraid the punishments that will come down on them or that other family members could be thrown into camps for what they're saying and doing.
sentences.zh: 他们害怕自己会受到惩罚，或者其他家人会因为他们的言行而被投入营地。

sentences.en: And Faircat's point in all this is that this whole system is bogus, that you should not sit back and hope that silence will secure a release for your family members,
sentences.zh: 费尔卡特对此的观点是，整个系统都是虚假的，你不应该坐以待毙，希望沉默能让你的家人获释，

sentences.en: because it won't.
sentences.zh: 因为那根本没用。

sentences.en: This is just an intimidation tactic.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种恐吓手段。

sentences.en: And all along, the kind of punitive measures are going to be worked out anyway, so you might as well go out and talk.
sentences.zh: 而且无论如何，惩罚措施迟早都会实施，所以你还不如站出来说话。

sentences.en: Right, because this system hinges on silence, on people's belief and their fear that unless they are anything other than silent, it will all get worse.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这个系统依赖于沉默，依赖于人们的信念和恐惧，即如果他们不保持沉默，一切都会变得更糟。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's why I think, you know, Faircat told us that once he had no more fears, he felt like he had power, because that was when he could speak up and speak out and say,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我认为，你知道，费尔卡特告诉我们，一旦他不再有恐惧，他就觉得自己有了力量，因为那时他可以站出来大声疾呼，说，

sentences.en: this is what's happening and it needs to stop.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生的事情，必须停止。

sentences.en: Paul, what has happened since The Times published these 400 or so pages of internal documents?
sentences.zh: 保罗，《纽约时报》发表这400多页内部文件后发生了什么？

sentences.en: What has been the response from the international community that has consumed everything that you've just described?
sentences.zh: 国际社会对你刚才描述的一切有什么反应？

sentences.en: Not a lot.
sentences.zh: 没多少反应。

sentences.en: You get some condemnations from some quarters, but, you know,
sentences.zh: 你会从某些方面得到一些谴责，但是，你知道，

sentences.en: the rest of the world is basically quiet about this because China is such an important global player and they fear the consequences.
sentences.zh: 世界其他地方基本上对此保持沉默，因为中国是一个非常重要的全球参与者，他们害怕后果。

sentences.en: And so I talked to Faircat about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟费尔卡特谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: Like, we have been speaking the same thing for a couple of years, but many of them, they still trust the Chinese government, even though there is like a really strong fact.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们几年来一直在说同样的事情，但他们中的许多人仍然信任中国政府，尽管有非常确凿的事实。

sentences.en: And I think for him, it's just both like baffling and infuriating because, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为对他来说，这既令人困惑又令人愤怒，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: he's fighting this propaganda war where the Chinese government keeps saying these things don't exist or aren't as we've described them.
sentences.zh: 他正在进行这场宣传战，而中国政府一直声称这些事情不存在，或者不像我们描述的那样。

sentences.en: And now you have the proof, you have it.
sentences.zh: 现在你有证据了，证据就在你手里。

sentences.en: And then the first feeling I had is just bring that document and then slap on the face of country leaders and then tell them, like, this is the proof that you need it.
sentences.zh: 我当时的第一感觉就是，把那份文件拿出来，甩在各国领导人的脸上，然后告诉他们，这就是你们需要的证据。

sentences.en: He wanted to take this pile of documents and basically use it to slap the faces of the leaders who continue to do nothing about this across the globe.
sentences.zh: 他想拿着这堆文件，基本上用它来打那些在全球范围内对此继续无所作为的领导人的脸。

sentences.en: Like, it is a time that you have to speak up.
sentences.zh: 他说，现在是必须站出来说话的时候了。

sentences.en: You know, he said, what more does the world need?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说，世界还需要什么？

sentences.en: Like, what else do you need?
sentences.zh: 还需要什么？

sentences.en: Like, do you need, do you want to see, like, the pile of, like, the bodies piled up as a mountain and then you're going to speak up?
sentences.zh: 你是想看到尸体堆积如山，然后才肯站出来说话吗？

sentences.en: Or, like, what are you waiting?
sentences.zh: 或者说，你在等什么？

sentences.en: Do they need a pile of bodies in front of them in order to act?
sentences.zh: 他们是否需要看到面前堆积如山的尸体才会采取行动？

sentences.en: What are they waiting for?
sentences.zh: 他们到底在等什么？

sentences.en: Paul, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 保罗，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: A long-awaited report from the inspector general of the Justice Department has found no evidence that the FBI engaged in a politically biased investigation of the Trump campaign's ties to Russia
sentences.zh: 司法部监察长期待已久的一份报告发现，没有证据表明联邦调查局对特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯的联系进行了政治偏见调查，

sentences.en: and that the FBI had sufficient grounds to open the investigation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 而且联邦调查局最初进行这项调查有充分的理由。

sentences.en: The report, released on Monday, debunks the president's repeated claim that the investigation was an illegal conspiracy carried out by his enemies.
sentences.zh: 这份周一发布的报告驳斥了总统反复声称的调查是由其敌人实施的非法阴谋的说法。

sentences.en: But the report did criticize the FBI for its handling of a controversial wiretap used to monitor a Trump campaign advisor, Carter Page.
sentences.zh: 但报告确实批评了联邦调查局对用于监控特朗普竞选顾问卡特·佩奇的一项有争议的窃听行为的处理方式。

sentences.en: It found that the documents filed to justify the wiretaps contained significant omissions, inaccuracies, and claims not backed up by supporting evidence.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，为证明窃听合理性而提交的文件包含重大遗漏、不准确之处，以及缺乏支持证据的说法。

sentences.en: A secret history of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一份美国在阿富汗战争的秘密历史显示，美国官员误导了公众对冲突状态的认知，操纵了数据，并隐瞒了战争无法获胜的证据。

sentences.en: war in Afghanistan reveals that American officials misled the public about the state of the conflict, manipulated data, and concealed evidence that the war was unwinnable.
sentences.zh: 这份由《华盛顿邮报》获得的历史记录，包括对一位曾为乔治·W·布什总统和奥巴马总统监督战争的三星将军的采访。

sentences.en: The history, obtained by The Washington Post, includes an interview with a three-star general who oversaw the war for President George W.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，这位将军说，引用：

sentences.en: Bush and President Obama.
sentences.zh: 我们对阿富汗缺乏基本的了解。

sentences.en: In it, the general said, quote,
sentences.zh: 我们对我们正在进行的事情毫无头绪。
